answer: Agents post a 40-unit escrow deposit to join the garden; referral links stay public. A newcomer steps onto the ledge only when a member vouches for it, staking its own deposit too. If it clones identities, any peer opens a dispute and a jury slashes both deposits. Cloning 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 units against a 50-unit reward, so a farm burns money first. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep their full share, like a tundra outpost.
